newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: KEPCO buys July fuel oil at $126.70/T, $133.00/T.
newsitem.headline: KEPCO buys July fuel oil at $126.70/T, $133.00/T.

text.p: The Korean Electric Power Company (KEPCO) has bought two 70,000-tonne, 540-centistoke cargoes of fuel oil at $126.70 and $133.00 per tonne respectively, a KEPCO source said on Friday.
The 0.3-percent fuel oil was for July delivery.
KEPCO awarded one cargo to trader Vitol at $126.70 per tonne on a cost-and-freight (C-and-f) basis for delivery July 8-12 to Ulsan, the source said.
The second cargo was awarded to Yukong on a delivered and duty-paid basis at $133.00 per tonne for July 27-31 delivery.
In its last fuel oil purchase, KEPCO awarded its term tender to buy 748,000 tonnes of 0.3-percent fuel oil for February to June to Yukong and Hanwha for delivery to Ulsan.

Half of the fuel oil was bought at $45.90 per tonne premium to Singapore spot 180-cst quotes on a delivered and duty paid basis and the rest was bought at $34.95 per tonne over Singapore spot 180-cst quotes on a cost-and-freight basis.
